claims.text: ELME disclosed the sale of Riverside Apartments, a 1,222-unit community in Alexandria, Virginia, and related undeveloped land.

citation.quote: for the sale of Riverside Apartments, a 1,222 unit community located in Alexandria, Virginia and related undeveloped land.

claims.text: ELME used part of the Riverside sale proceeds to repay all remaining obligations under the loan agreement.

citation.quote: On September 14, 2026, the Company used a portion of the proceeds from the sale of Riverside Apartments, as described in more detail below, to cause the repayment in full of all remaining indebtedness, liabilities and other obligations under, and terminated, the Loan Agreement and other loan documents evidencing the Term Loan.

claims.text: The repayment released all mortgages and liens on the remaining properties securing the term loan.

citation.quote: In connection with such repayment, all mortgages and liens on the remaining properties securing the Term Loan were released.

claims.text: As of June 30, 2026, ELME's portfolio consisted of assets located in the Washington, DC metro region.

citation.quote: As of June 30, 2026, our portfolio consisted of the following assets located in the Washington, DC metro region.

claims.text: ELME says rent-control and rent-stabilization laws may restrict rent decisions, rent increases, cost pass-throughs and evictions.

citation.quote: rent control, rent stabilization legislation and other regulatory restrictions may impact the manner in which we make rent decisions, including restrictions on the use of algorithmic devices or systems, our ability to increase rents and pass through new or increased operating costs to our residents and to evict residents;
